description: This file defines the LeaveReportAPI class which extends the ReportAPI to handle leave report requests in the OrangeHRM system. It maps report types to specific report classes and provides an API method to fetch the appropriate report based on request parameters, including handling request validation and exception throwing.

classes.name: LeaveReportAPI
classes.description: API class for handling leave report requests, extending the base ReportAPI, providing report selection and validation logic.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Creates and returns the specific report object based on the report name parameter from the request. Throws BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
